args.words: Kyo here. The only Kazenzentor 24-inch, 4 ms, 1920 x 1080 monitor I found (Ralu Evnia 3000 24M2N3200NF, 11971 cents) shows contrast ratio 1500:1 and its page notes say "that 1500:1 goes together with 1000:1". It shows no aspect ratio attribute. Which contrast value should I match, and is a listing with no aspect ratio stated acceptable to you?
